_note: Money in the game (garage/player). Prices are the parts' and cars' own (their files). Selling: price × sell.ratio × the condition curve at the part's condition (straight lines between the points). Repairing to 100%: price × repair.perPoint × the points missing, at least repair.minimum (dents with no points missing: the minimum). The body shell repairs the same way from its own price (car.json shell.price), plus repair.breakable for each broken window or light. A part with mechanical damage (bent, leaking, worn: garage/mechanical.js) costs price × repair.mechanical more to put right (at least repair.minimum). Parts that go on a group of sockets (wheels, tyres, spacers) are bought as a set of that many. A new car costs its class's carPrices × its priceFactor (car.json).
